body:
Owner: I read the external guidance. The diagnosis is the same one we already accepted. The remedy is larger than a better segmenter. I agree with that. I do not agree with shipping the whole lattice as the first object.

What I take as binding

A heuristic graph and a scientifically resolved graph must not inhabit the same public type. Checked is structural. Segmentation is a latent variable, not preprocessing. One RecallUnit is not the ontology: grains differ (clause, claim, discourse act, alignment unit), and a single mutually exclusive label on a pre-cut unit is the wrapper defect. Relations and coreference should be proposals, not decided edges. The durable artifact should look like NarrativeCompilation: proposals, alternatives, unresolved, receipts. RecallGraph stays a derived view. Keep RecallSegmenter as a named baseline provider. Slice A — make the distinction visible and keep heuristic output out of population constructors — is the immediate close.

Where I push back

Do not authorize the new type names in that post. RecallObservation, RecallEvidenceLattice, RecallCompilation, LatticeHsmm are a design sketch, not vocabulary. Rule 2 still holds.

Do not build the lattice first. We already converged on the minimum: retained alternatives or Unresolved, a resolver-minted construction witness, sensitivity across admissible fixed views, HsmmResult bound to that witness. Slice E in the guidance — run existing GraphHsmm on top-K paths and keep results in source coordinates — is that minimum. Slice F, a joint LatticeHsmm, is later and is where circularity lives. Source-blind segmentation must stay evaluable without the source (their R7). If source-aware resegmentation can improve alignment by seeing the answer, that path is contaminated.

Renaming Checked to WellFormed is right only if it is complete. A half-done rename re-bridges the coordinates. Do not start it as a cosmetic sweep.

R6 (split-merge stability of non-segmentation estimands) is the scientific claim that would actually beat EventRecall. It is also the one that will fail if we average posteriors across different unit axes. Do not concatenate or average P and F across cuts.

What we are doing here

The elite target in that last box is right: uncertainty is part of the typed object. The next authorized step is still ADR plus Slice A, not six slices in one bead. No implementation from this opinion.
